name: The Looping Labyrinth
realm: Repeat the incantation until the door opens.
lesson:
Loops repeat code:
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { ... }   // runs 5 times: i = 0..4
    while (condition) { ... }              // runs while true
    do { ... } while (condition);          // runs at least once
  'break' escapes the loop.  'continue' skips to the next round.

trial.prompt: How many times does this loop run?

trial.code: for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) cout << i;

trial.prompt: Which loop ALWAYS runs at least once?
trial.hint: It checks the condition at the END.
trial.explain: do-while checks after the body, so it runs at least once.

pool.prompt: Which statement skips the rest of THIS loop pass?
pool.explain: continue jumps to the next iteration.

pool.prompt: How many times does this run?

boss.hint: continue skips evens. break stops at 4.
boss.explain: 0 skipped, 1 printed, 2 skipped, 3 printed, 4 -> break. Output: 13
i is never incremented: infinite loop! The Minotaur's corridor never ends.

boss.prompt: What is the final value of sum?
boss.code:
int sum = 0;
for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++) sum += i;

spell.hint: for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) cout << i << endl;
